content.short: M0 is a decentralized infrastructure layer for institutionally issued stablecoins backed by real-world assets and security.
content.description: M0 is an innovative decentralized infrastructure protocol designed to facilitate the institutional issuance of cryptographically-backed stablecoins. Rather than being a single stablecoin issuer, M0 provides the foundational layer that allows various financial institutions to mint their own digital dollars, such as the $M stablecoin, backed by high-quality real-world assets (RWAs) like short-term US Treasuries. This approach aims to bring institutional-grade liquidity and compliance to the decentralized finance ecosystem. Often described as the "Stripe for stablecoins," M0 simplifies the tokenization process.
